algorithm_review.owner: vendor/kurbo/src/stroke.rs:443-530; unchanged Kurvst mark/curve owners call this patched Kurbo, as does native SVG geometry
algorithm_review.scaling: For finite nonzero tangent, the largest component is divided by its power-of-two binade, yielding maximum magnitude in [1,2). The explicit subnormal branch chooses its leading mantissa bit; largest==0 prevents leading-zero shift misuse. Exact power-of-two scaling preserves representable direction bits and bounds norm/dot products. This does not promise preservation of arbitrarily tiny relative components or repair other unscaled stroker stages.
algorithm_review.determinant: The two mul_add residual terms compensate cancellation of the two determinant products. Its orientation drives the unchanged outside/inside branch. Reflection and both signs are exercised.
algorithm_review.ratio: For dot<0 the rationalized square-root product divided by |cross| avoids cancellation in hypot+dot and avoids forming cross squared. For dot>=0 the original stable sum is used. No angle epsilon, miter inflation, clamping, or input rejection was introduced. A true half-turn has infinite ratio and remains excluded by a finite limit; the strict less-than comparison is retained.
algorithm_review.intersection: Offsets are formed at the vertex before translation. The cross-positive branch intersects the right-hand offsets and the cross-negative branch the left-hand offsets. Both use the scaled tangent consistently in determinant and displacement, then translate once. The opposite side still goes through the pivot. This removes translated-offset subtraction loss without adding a mark-specific stroker.
algorithm_review.ordinary_controls: 144 independent generic join/cap/zero-length/half-turn controls have exactly equal old/new serialized vertices. The 348 existing/current geometry/native-SVG tests cover curves, composites, barbs, round joins and endcaps.
algorithm_review.boundary_controls: Six independently selected limits at 8 ULPs below/above the offset-intersection ratio cover both allowed and clipped cases. All pass. True zero-length and exact half-turn paths remain finite in ordinary scale controls.
algorithm_review.unmodified_limits: 160 deliberately subnormal generic cases at tangent/width 1e-310 produce nonfinite endpoints in BOTH old and patched Kurbo: do_line still uses Vec2::hypot implemented as sqrt(x*x+y*y), so squared tangents underflow. They are recorded as existing limitations, never passing checks. Twelve nearly parallel cases miss an intentionally tighter vertex bound equally in both versions; errors 2.5e-13 or 8.88e-11 remain below the requested 1e-9 accuracy. There is no newly nonfinite case where old output is finite.

mark_oracle.method: Decimal line intersections of exact emitted binary64 coordinates using perpendicular distance to each line, not the patched half-angle/compensated algorithm. Each expected miter is below the unchanged emitted limit. Independent nonzero winding at 75% of each corner displacement checks actual serialized outline interiors.
mark_oracle.bound: 64 * binary64 epsilon * max(1, |u||v|/|det(u,v)|) * (|vertex| + |miter displacement| + stroke scale), which includes conditioning of represented edge subtraction. Maximum observed error/bound = 0.00486931.

generic_oracle.method: Independent offset-line intersections for rotated/reflected/translated V paths, scales 1e-150 through 1e150 plus subnormal diagnostics; 1e-4 through 1e-14 angles. Separate exact-position and rounded-edge oracles isolate input edge subtraction conditioning.
generic_oracle.bound: 256 epsilon times vertex + displacement + edge length norms, plus 32 ULPs of stroke width, for the finite V corner checks. Maximum observed V error/bound = 0.00542681. Near-parallel tolerance diagnostics remain in the raw report and are classified separately, not silently removed.

independent_math.public_generic: 18 fresh actual WASM curve-outline cases cover three scales, three thin-turn angles, signed reflections and clipped controls through the general kurvst.outline API.
independent_math.new_assertions: The 15-case analytic lobe-inradius native matrix and 9-case public matrix are additions, not relaxed prior assertions. 128 epsilon times grown extent for front cancellation and 32 epsilon/(1-inset) for wing conditioning are conservative for these constructions; independent exact-emitted-edge checks distinguish this allowance from accepting a missing miter.

blank_render_adjudication.decision: NOT a geometry-scope blocker; explicitly NOT visual coverage proof. A clearly qualified downstream precision/resolution limit remains.
blank_render_adjudication.pipeline: Both geometry routes construct the same local path and patched Kurbo expanded outline. Public geometry serializes outline/outline-bounds and native SVG uses the outline for bounds/hit geometry. Actual painting diverges after that boundary: native SVG output.rs:359-366 emits the original path plus stroke/miter settings; Linnest draw.typ:1930-1953 does likewise and adds the expanded outline only as a hidden bounds path. Typst rasterization re-strokes in its own renderer.
blank_render_adjudication.fresh_observations: Both-theme boundary SVG/PNG renders are byte-identical to candidate evidence and were visually inspected. The thin-triangle tip crops remain blank. Current public outline-elements include the repaired tip at (100.00000013411045,0). Independent exact winding is 1 at (99,0) and (92,0), and 0 at (92,0.001).
blank_render_adjudication.numeric_crop_bound: At the gallery crop 8 units behind the tip and zoom 10, the reviewed 10x1e-7 triangle is at most 1.600000027e-6 pixel thick at 144dpi. Its entire triangular crop area is about 0.000128 pixel squared, below one 8-bit alpha quantum (1/255). Even an ideal area renderer need not produce a visible pixel. The nearby 10x1e-5 control has maximum thickness about 0.00016 pixel, also below per-pixel alpha resolution.
blank_render_adjudication.backend_cause: Static source trace in local pinned-version typst-render 0.15.1 shape.rs:55-81,89-105 converts path/stroke to f32 and calls tiny-skia. tiny-skia-path 0.12.0 stroker.rs:1352-1366,1595-1612 classifies 1+dot within 1/4096 as Nearly180 and takes a blunt/bevel path before normal miter evaluation. For this near-opposite direction dot rounds to -1 in f32. This independent backend cutoff can omit the geometric miter even with a sufficient miter limit; this review did not instrument the renderer to claim a pixel-level proof of that branch.
blank_render_adjudication.practical_contract: The corrected numeric outline, footprint, contacts and ordinary native/Typst behavior satisfy this source38 scope. No guarantee of every finite binary64 shape in every SVG/GPU/raster backend is credited. If faithful extreme raster painting is made a separate requirement, fix that renderer owner or deliberately paint the already authoritative expanded outline while preserving separate fill/stroke semantics; increasing limits cannot fix this cutoff.
